responsibility: This header customizes the MIPS SDE target for use with the SDE C library instead of newlib. It defines SDE-specific preprocessor builtins and assertions, exposes deprecated compatibility macros for ISA/FPR detection, wires libgcc and inline cache-flush support to the SDE library’s mips_sync_icache entry point, and overrides function profiling conventions such as _mcount argument/register handling and saved return-address policy, making it the runtime-library integration companion to sde.h.
